problem_type: A superseded project open is reported as a creation failure and repeated activations create duplicate projects
symptom: After the app recovered from a freeze, the project library showed '新建项目失败，请检查本地磁盘权限' although the disk was fine. Reproduced by clicking 新建空白项目 twice quickly: two empty projects are created and the banner appears when returning to the library.
direct_cause: createAndOpenProject created a project on every activation and awaited hydrateProject; the second activation's hydration supersedes the first, which rejects with ProjectHydrationSupersededError, and the newProject / playJourneyTour entries reported every rejection as a creation failure.
class_root: The single creation orchestration point did not own two rules that every other open entry already follows: an open superseded by a newer open is not a failure, and a creation still in flight must not be started again by queued activations.
affected_population: Any user whose clicks queue up while the UI is busy or frozen, or who double-clicks 新建空白项目
Users who start a new project and immediately open another project card
The guided demo entry (重看一遍引导) that goes through the same orchestration
entry_points: 重看一遍引导 demo project (playJourneyTour -> createAndOpenProject)
Leaving a project for the library (useProjectLeaveAction), which already de-duplicated repeated calls with a hand-written copy of the same rule
internal_only_reason: Application-owned orchestration: ProjectHydrationSupersededError and hydrateProject are Nomi code; the other open entries (openProject, openWorkspaceFolder, route hydration, notification navigation) were read to align with their existing handling.
invariants: At most one create-and-open runs at a time; activations while it is in flight receive the same outcome
A created project whose open is superseded resolves as opened:false and is never reported as a failure
Real creation or open failures still reach the entry that reports them

invariant_owner_layer.why: projectCreationFlight owns both rules (one in-flight operation per slot; superseded open is not a failure); createAndOpenProject and useProjectLeaveAction consume it, and both layers keep their own tests.

door_reduction.why_not: The remaining doors are distinct owners: the error type's definition site, each hydration consumer (studio routes, notification navigation), the new-project and demo entries that share createAndOpenProject, and project leave. The hand-written in-flight copy in useProjectLeaveAction was merged into shareInFlight, which is the one reduction; the superseded consumers already handle the error and are listed so the next reader sees every place that must keep doing so.

generality_proof: Both creation entries go through createAndOpenProject, which now runs inside shareInFlight and opens through openCreatedProject, so neither entry can create a duplicate or surface a superseded open. Project leave uses the same shareInFlight, so 'repeat triggers share one pending operation' has one definition in the project lifecycle.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: One pending operation per slot; repeated triggers share it; settles (success or failure) release the slot.
Maps a superseded open of a just-created project to opened:false and rethrows every other failure.
The only create-and-open orchestration; routes through both helpers.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls createAndOpenProject; real app: two rapid clicks now create one project and no banner (before: two projects plus 新建项目失败).
Calls createAndOpenProject and starts the tour only when opened is true; a superseded open now resolves opened:false instead of reporting demoProjectFailed.
Now delegates to shareInFlight; existing test 'shares a pending library exit across repeated calls and allows retry after a failed save' still passes.
Already catches ProjectHydrationSupersededError and returns false without reporting; it creates nothing.
Its caller openWorkspaceFolder in NomiStudioApp swallows ProjectHydrationSupersededError; folder opens bind an existing folder and are idempotent by rootPath.

recurrence.reason: Any busy or frozen UI queues clicks, and any user can double-click or switch projects during creation; every such case produced a duplicate project or a false failure banner.
same_class_scan: door-map shareInFlight openCreatedProject createAndOpenProject ProjectHydrationSupersededError: 9 doors
door-map hydrateProject: every consumer except createAndOpenProject already filtered ProjectHydrationSupersededError (openProject, openWorkspaceFolder, route effects, notification target)
rg 'pending.current' in src/workbench/project: the only other in-flight de-duplication was useProjectLeaveAction, now merged

prevention.invariant: One create-and-open in flight; a superseded open is not a failure
prevention.failure_mode: Repeated activations resolve to the in-flight outcome; real failures still reject to the reporting entry
prevention.strategy: Own both rules in the helper that the single orchestration point must use, and merge the pre-existing hand-written in-flight copy into it.

legacy_paths.rationale: The hand-written pending-promise de-duplication inside useProjectLeaveAction was deleted in favour of shareInFlight; createAndOpenProject's unguarded create-then-hydrate body was replaced in place.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party runtime controls project creation or hydration ordering.

migration: No stored data changes. Projects duplicated by the old behaviour remain as ordinary empty drafts and are reclaimed by the existing empty-draft GC on the next launch.
residual_risks: A creation triggered from a different entry while another is in flight (e.g. 新建 then 重看引导 within the same second) returns the first outcome and drops the second request; acceptable because both land in the same hydration view, but not user-tested.
The first creation after a cold start still blocks the renderer about 1.3 s (second creation 0.23 s); not addressed here.
